text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, out on the racetrack... there are 
"connections."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"That 'connection' we lost that day, 
separated by a sheer cliff."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"A future that has faded away. Now, I 
will—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Connected by a single "REEN".

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Uni-san.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: An irreplaceable “ZEER”.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Let's go, let's go, Universe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: A "KELT" reaching out.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: More precious than anyone...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Everything" exists here, on this planet. 
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Neo Universe wants to achieve 
completion. In this 'Japan Cup'."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy, with Hishi Miracle— A 
"teardrop-shaped vessel" toward the 
future.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The "Great King" has already 
stepped into the maelstrom. I can even 
hear the swell of the "singularity"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I thought the "teardrop-shaped craft" 
would control those two units. But...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Its shape became slightly... obscured.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I want to see for myself what kind of ship 
this is, and where it's headed. As the 
"captain."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Neo Universe will make a 
"confession."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "I want to win—the two of us together."

Whether those words were truly uttered in 
that exact voice, I do not know. But...

Neo Universe made it crystal clear. Her 
will to seize victory, that is.

The destination of a journey. That is the 
Japan Cup.

In order to decide how to move forward 
into the era that follows—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ..."Mutef."
Neo Universe chews on the words.

At long last—the launch into the decisive 
battle.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: To Trainer... DSN—transmitting.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Look at 'me' from space... and come back, 
okay? Come back... So..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Please... welcome Neo Universe.
